what: ActiveCampaign users report sharp price increases (up to 4x), AI-only support that fails, and surprise bill hikes without notice. Many SMBs stuck due to migration costs.
why_us: High willingness to switch for transparent, human-support, simpler email+CRM with fair pricing. Classic overpriced incumbent pain.
revenue: Implied high LTV; users already paying hundreds/month and complaining
engagement: 147+ recent reviews, multiple 1-star calling it 'sh*****' and 'too expensive'

what: HubSpot repeatedly called overpriced, overcomplicated, and aggressive upsell for SMBs. Users report contact overcharging bugs and unresponsive support during critical campaigns.
why_us: Massive market of SMBs looking for simpler CRM/email that doesn't milk them. Proven switching intent.
revenue: Users paying thousands and still unhappy
engagement: Dozens of 1-star reviews Nov 2026, 'waste of money', 'complete waste'

what: Apollo.io G2 reviews: steep learning curve, expensive credits/subscriptions that scale poorly, AI features degrading UX, slow performance on large lists.
why_us: Sales intelligence tool with clear product-market pain on pricing and usability. Opportunity for focused, cheaper alternative.
engagement: 91 mentions learning curve, 76 mentions high costs

what: Dictation app (usevoicy.com) stuck at ~$12.5k MRR. Single acquisition channel (SEO), 200+ competitors, 7% churn. Founder planning conversion optimization and feature cleanup before new channels.
why_us: Real revenue numbers + concrete bottlenecks in a crowded AI tool category. Shows what works and where it plateaus.

what: First iOS app launched: 106 users and 11 free trials in 3 days, $0 MRR so far. Organic via X/Reddit/FB groups + AI UGC. Paywall timing is key feedback.
why_us: Fresh micro-SaaS launch data showing organic growth speed and early conversion challenges.

what: HN 'Still Unbuilt' analysis of 12k+ requests: strong demand for privacy/local tools, mute button for news feeds, paid Windows without junk/telemetry, ad-free browser/search/email. 27% of recent asks are better versions of existing software.
why_us: Long-term, high-signal demand for ownership and less bloat/AI slop. Multiple years of repeated asks.
revenue: High 'would pay' percentages (60-80% in top categories)
engagement: Aggregated from 63k comments, top items 30-45 asks across years

what: Founder shared how first LinkedIn post about $1.5k MRR Reddit tool led to $500k investment. Building in public with real numbers works.
why_us: Proof of distribution leverage from transparent revenue sharing.

what: Salesforce Trustpilot: expensive, poor account management, overcharging, bad support. Multiple 'worst financial mistake' and 'complete waste' reviews from startups and SMBs.
why_us: Enterprise giant with clear SMB dissatisfaction. Opportunity in simpler sales tools.
